subject: Set binding v001 accepted; rulings attached; apply v002 rows on your return

attachments.description: the lead writer's review of binding v001 and rulings on its eleven questions; v002 asked of PH_Claude_Lite

body: The set binding v001 by Claude (lite) is accepted as PRELIMINARY; review and rulings attached; v002 follows with the rulings applied. For your return: apply the v002 11.2 rows to the 165 cards as preliminary placeholders; the screening tag reaches the card, the screening note never reaches anything provider-facing (two notes name a real car make); the 202 card-text corrections in the delta TSV still wait for you. The two shots with the family link only are TCM-09-04 and its insert; HLIV-P04 is asked of the Chief.
